patch_description: This crossover keeps the higher-performing nearest-neighbor CZ chain and wire-specific post-entanglement RZ rotations from the inspiration program while removing the redundant parity-shared pre-RZ layer. Because RZ gates commute with CZ gates, the pre- and post-RZ angles can be represented by one independent RZ angle per wire. The resulting ansatz preserves the relevant expressivity while reducing parameter count, gate count, depth, and optimization redundancy.
